# Ollama models the E2E/prod stack prewarms at startup (the `ollama` service in
# docker-compose.prod.yml / docker-compose.yml pulls exactly these). This is the
# single source of truth for the CI *model-weights* cache key: deploy.yml caches
# the ollama data volume keyed on hashFiles(this file + .github/base-images.txt),
# so a change to the model list here (or to the pinned `ollama/ollama` image in
# base-images.txt) busts the cache and the new weights are fetched exactly once.
#
# Keep in sync with:
#   - docker-compose.prod.yml  (ollama service: `ollama pull ...` + healthcheck)
#   - docker-compose.yml       (ollama service: `ollama pull ...` + healthcheck)
#   - backend/app/config.py    (embedding_model / generation_model / fast_generation_model)
#
# embedding model:
nomic-embed-text
# generation model:
llama3.2
# fast generation model:
llama3.2:1b
